description: Split periodic project equity cash flows between LP and GP: preferred return (compounding or simple) and return of capital pro rata to capital in either order, an optional GP catch-up, IRR-hurdle tiers with promote splits measured on the LP's IRR, and a residual split. Returns per-period LP and GP contributions and distributions (with the GP's promote) that foot to the cent, and LP, GP, and project IRRs and multiples, with the conventions to confirm against the operating agreement. Deterministic: use this instead of doing the math yourself; cite formula calc.equity_waterfall@1 and the returned steps, and surface any warnings.

cash_flows.description: Project-level equity cash flows at t = 0, 1, 2, … periods: negative = capital contributed by the investors, positive = cash available to distribute. At most 600.

catch_up.description: GP catch-up after the pref and return of capital. Omit for none.

gp_share.description: Share of each catch-up dollar paid to the GP as promote, e.g. 1 for a full catch-up or 0.5 for a 50% catch-up; the rest goes to the investors pro rata.

target_promote.description: Catch-up continues until the GP's promote is this share of all profit distributed so far (everything other than return of capital), e.g. 0.2. Must be below gp_share.

distribution_order.description: Which comes first from each distribution: accrued pref, then return of capital (the usual order), or capital first.

lp_share.description: Share of every contribution funded by the LP, e.g. 0.9; the GP co-invests the rest (1 for no GP capital). Capital, pref, and the non-promote part of every split are shared in this ratio.

periods_per_year.description: Cash-flow periods per year: 1 annual, 4 quarterly, 12 monthly. Sets the pref accrual per period and annualizes the IRRs.

pref.description: Preferred return on unreturned capital, paid to all investors pro rata to capital. Omit for none.

compounding.description: "compound": unpaid pref earns pref, at the effective periodic rate (1 + rate)^(1 ÷ periods_per_year) − 1, so a fully paid pref is an IRR of rate on the capital. "simple": each period accrues unreturned capital × rate ÷ periods_per_year, and unpaid pref earns nothing.

residual_promote.description: GP promote share of everything after the last tier, e.g. 0.3 for a 70/30 split.

tiers.description: IRR-hurdle tiers after the catch-up, in increasing until_irr order: each distributes with its promote until the LP's IRR reaches until_irr.

promote.description: Share of each dollar in this tier paid to the GP as promote, e.g. 0.2 for an 80/20 split; the rest goes to the investors pro rata to capital.

until_irr.description: LP IRR hurdle (annual, as calc_irr annualizes) that ends this tier, e.g. 0.12.

name: calc_equity_waterfall
title: LP/GP equity distribution waterfall
